groups.name: Cheat Master
groups.bonus: Any cheat code you find in the world counts as entered right, no matter the inputs.

groups.name: Loot Hacker
groups.bonus: Better odds of items from Loot Hacks.

groups.name: Quack
groups.bonus: The Quack Sprite shares 50% of its earned Sprite XP with other Sprites in your inventory.

groups.name: Fortune
groups.bonus: Highlights chests close to you, in addition to the base ability.

groups.name: Cursed
groups.bonus: Improves rare-variant odds. Being in water deals damage while this Sprite is equipped.

sprites.name: Jonesy Sprite
sprites.how: In your inventory at match start
sprites.does: After you take damage, it heals back some health or shield after a short delay.
sprites.levels: Heals more with each level.

sprites.name: Adventure Sprite
sprites.how: In your inventory at match start
sprites.does: Upgrades a random item in your inventory.
sprites.levels: Each level upgrades another random item.

sprites.name: Bush Sprite
sprites.how: In your inventory at match start
sprites.does: After a short wait, it gives you a bush to hide in. Maxed out, every elimination gives you a fresh bush too.
sprites.levels: The bush shows up faster with each level.

sprites.name: 8-Bit Sprite
sprites.does: Its first chest can hold an 8-Bit Shotgun that racks up a score multiplier.

sprites.name: Birthday Sprite
sprites.how: Cheat code FM1 at the Admin Panel
sprites.does: Chests sometimes drop a slice of cake. Maxed out, eliminations can drop cake too.
sprites.levels: Better cake odds with each level.

sprites.name: Storm Scout Sprite
sprites.does: Taking enough storm damage kicks you into Overdrive. Maxed out, it shows where the next storm circles will be.
sprites.levels: Overdrive lasts longer with each level.

sprites.name: Overshield Sprite
sprites.does: Gives you an extra layer of shield.
sprites.levels: Bigger shield with each level.

sprites.name: Onigiri Sprite
sprites.does: Eating or drinking anything kicks you into Overdrive.
sprites.levels: Overdrive lasts longer with each level.

sprites.name: Mega Man Sprite
sprites.does: Slides go farther and smoother, with less friction.
sprites.levels: Slides farther with each level.

sprites.name: Pond Sprite
sprites.does: Jump again right after landing for a super jump. Charges refill over time.
sprites.levels: Higher super jumps and faster recharge with each level.

sprites.name: Morgana Sprite
sprites.does: Your healing items heal you for more.
sprites.levels: Extra healing grows with each level.

sprites.name: Sonic Sprite
sprites.does: Makes you sprint faster.
sprites.levels: Even faster with each level.

sprites.name: Tails Sprite
sprites.does: Jump, then hover and glide through the air with Tails.
sprites.levels: Hovers faster with each level.

sprites.name: Shadow Sprite
sprites.does: Slowly reloads the weapons you aren't holding. Maxed out, it reloads the one in your hands too.
sprites.levels: Reloads faster with each level.

sprites.name: Killswitch Sprite
sprites.does: Kicks in while you aim in midair, giving you hang time and sharper shots.
sprites.levels: More accurate with each level.
sprites.where: Out in the world at night

sprites.name: Blinky Sprite
sprites.does: Every time you get hit, it cloaks you for a moment.
sprites.levels: The cloak lasts longer with each level.

sprites.does: After a short wait, it gives you a bush to hide in. Maxed out, every elimination gives you a fresh bush too.
sprites.levels: The bush shows up faster with each level.

sprites.name: Quack Klombo Sprite

sprites.levels: Better items with each level.

sprites.name: Quack Spooky Dash Sprite

sprites.levels: Faster recharge with each level.

sprites.name: Halfpeel'd Sprite
sprites.how: On Crossbones Isle, tear a Wanted Poster off a wall. Follow its Sprite Treasure Map, dig at the marked spot with your pickaxe, then open the buried Sprite Chest. The Sprite you receive is random.
sprites.does: Shows elimination locations on your map.
sprites.levels: Each level expands its detection radius.
